title: Forward your existing number to Luubu
blurb: Keep the number customers know and send calls through Luubu Phone.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Phone System
steps.body: Click **Phone System** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: Copy your Luubu number
steps.body: Click **Phone Numbers** and note your Luubu Phone number.
steps.tip: See **Your phone system requires configuration**? We need to switch Luubu Phone on for you. Email hello@luubu.com.

steps.title: Divert your old number
steps.body: On a mobile, turn on call forwarding in your phone settings (on iPhone: Settings, Phone, Call Forwarding) and enter your Luubu number. Landlines and business lines vary, so ask your provider how to divert.

steps.title: Avoid a loop
steps.body: Make sure your Luubu number does not ring back to the number you just diverted, or calls go round in circles.

steps.title: Test it
steps.body: Ring your old number from another phone and check it comes through Luubu.
steps.tip: Want to move the number to Luubu for good? Email hello@luubu.com about porting.
